segments.text: The Brihat Jataka holds that a Damini yoga makes a person
liberal in gift, will delight in helping others and will possess many cows.
If all the benefic planets occupy the Upachaya places from the ascendant at the time of birth, a person will be very rich
if one of them occupy such places he will possess small wealth
even if the person be born in other malefic Yogas the present yoga will take effect to their exclusion

.

The Brihat Jataka holds that with the Sun in the 10th house,
the person will live in comfort and will be powerful

.

Varahamihira counts the Sunapha yoga as a combination of planets around the Moon, where
excepting the Sun if the other planets occupy the 2nd, the 12th, or both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Moon, the yoga is respectively known as Sunapha, Anapha or Durudhura

a person born in a Sunapha yoga will be possessed of self-acquired property, will be [someone with standing] or will resemble [someone with standing], and will be a man of intelligence, wealth and renown.
The Brihat Jataka describes the Anapha yoga as bringing
a man of influence and authority, will be [of robust health], will have a control over his passions, will be of great renown
. When Saturn is the yoga planet, the book adds that
a person will enjoy the wealth, property and servants of others, will engage in various deeds and will be the chief of parties of men

sources.text: A person born under a Damini yoga will be liberal in gift, will delight in helping others and will possess many cows.

If all the benefic planets (a) occupy the Upachaya places (b) from the ascendant at the time of birth, a person will be very rich and if they occupy the Upachaya places from the Moon, he will be moderately rich. If two of the planets occupy the Upachaya places a person will be moderately wealthy and if one of them occupy such places he will possess small wealth (c). Even if the person be born in other malefic Yogas (d) the present yoga will take effect to their exclusion (e).
if he occupy the 10th house, the person will live in comfort and will be powerful;
Excepting the Sun if the other planets occupy the 2nd, the 12th, or both the 2nd and the 12th houses from the Moon, the yoga is respectively known as Sunapha, Anapha or Durudhura ;
A person born in a Sunapha yoga will be possessed of self-acquired property, will be a king or will resemble a king, and will be a man of intelligence, wealth and renown.

A person born in an Anapha yoga will be a man of influence and authority, will be free from diseases, will have a control over his passions, will be of great renown, will be in the enjoyment of all manner of pleasures, will wear neat dress and will be free from grief.
If the yoga planet be Saturn, a person will enjoy the wealth, property and servants of others, will engage in various deeds and will be the chief of parties of men (a).
